Trigger.Name: POST-CHANGE
Trigger.TriggerText: BEGIN SELECT DEST_CODE, CITY_LABEL INTO :DESTINATION, :DEST_LABEL FROM SOURCE_ROUTES, SOURCE_CITIES WHERE ROUTE_CODE = :ROUTE AND CITY_CODE = DEST_CODE; EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN :DESTINATION := NULL; :DEST_LABEL := NULL; END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText: BEGIN SELECT CITY_LABEL INTO :TO_CITY FROM SOURCE_CITIES WHERE CITY_CODE = :THRU; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN :TO_CITY := NULL; END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText: BEGIN SELECT QTY, DESCRIPTION, CITY_CODE, SERVICE_CODE INTO :QTY, :DESCRIPTION, :CITY, :SERVICE FROM SOURCE_SHIPMENTS WHERE CODE = :CODE; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN :QTY := NULL; :DESCRIPTION := NULL; :CITY := NULL; :SERVICE := NULL; END;
